modern: If you are able, correct by teaching those who do wrong; but if you cannot, remember that patience has been given to you for this purpose. And the gods too are patient with such people; and for some purposes they even help them to get health, wealth, reputation; so kind are they. And it is in your power too; or tell me, who stops you?
original: If thou art able, correct by teaching those who do wrong; but if thou canst not, remember that indulgence is given to thee for this purpose. And the gods, too, are indulgent to such persons; and for some purposes they even help them to get health, wealth, reputation; so kind they are. And it is in thy power also; or say, who hinders thee?
